name: Otto Hahn
marburg_connection: Studied chemistry and earned his doctorate at Marburg University.

name: Robert Bunsen
marburg_connection: Conducted research and taught chemistry at Marburg.

name: Emil von Behring
marburg_connection: Professor of Hygiene at Marburg from 1895 until his death; received the first Nobel Prize in Medicine while at Marburg.

name: Jacob Grimm
marburg_connection: Studied at Marburg and was mentored by Friedrich Carl von Savigny.

name: Hannah Arendt
marburg_connection: Enrolled to study philosophy at Marburg in 1924 and remained for three semesters.

name: K. Ferdinand Braun
marburg_connection: Studied at Marburg and was a professor of mathematical physics there from 1877 to 1880.

name: Alfred Wegener
marburg_connection: Developed the theory of continental drift while working at Marburg.

name: Boris Pasternak
marburg_connection: Spent an exchange semester at Marburg University in 1912.
